The bull-bear spread fell to -24.5%, as elevated oil prices, a Fed rate hike and market volatility fuelled caution among individual investors.

title: Howard Buffett to take charge as Berkshire Hathaway chairman: Who is he?
description: Howard Buffett is set to become Berkshire Hathaway's new chairman, succeeding his father Warren Buffett, who will become chairman emeritus. The 71-year-old has served on Berkshire's board for 33 years and is expected to focus on preserving its culture. His career spans business, farming, conservation, law enforcement and philanthropy.

title: Global Markets: French bond spread at highest since 2012 as default insurance spikes
description: Amid rising investor concerns surrounding France's fiscal health leading up to next year's elections, risk premiums on French government bonds have surged to levels not seen since the euro zone debt crisis. The country grapples with a tough budget situation, prompting plans for a substantial savings initiative aimed at mitigating the increasing budget deficit, which has impacted French banking stocks and the main stock index significantly.

title: US Treasury yields rise as investors weigh outlook for rate hikes
description: As investors analyze the economic landscape, US Treasury yields have seen an uptick, fueled by discussions around future rate hikes by the Federal Reserve. The Bank of Japan has also joined the trend, elevating interest rates to their highest point in thirty-one years. Meanwhile, global inflation pressures are exacerbating the situation, propelling a new phase of rate tightening.

title: HDFC Mutual Fund buys 13.9 lakh Entero Healthcare shares from Prasid Uno Family Trust in Rs 236 crore block deal
description: HDFC Mutual Fund bought 13.90 lakh Entero Healthcare Solutions shares worth Rs 235.6 crore through a block deal at Rs 1,695 apiece. Prasid Uno Family Trust sold the shares, representing about 3.19% of the company’s equity, amid recent stock gains.

title: Lenskart block deal: Rs 2,047 crore stake sale likely; Platinum Jasmine may offload 1.7% holding
description: Bitcoin has gained 61.7% over five years, outperforming Ethereum and Solana, which declined 26.2% and 27.9%. Analysts attribute Bitcoin’s lead to institutional adoption, ETF flows, liquidity and scarcity, while Ethereum and Solana remain more sensitive to network activity and crypto narratives.

title: US Federal Reserve's Michelle Bowman says changes to bank stress test coming soon
description: The Federal Reserve will soon vote on revamped bank stress tests.  These changes aim for greater transparency and predictability for lenders.  More details about testing models will be disclosed to the public.  Results from two recent tests will determine capital buffer requirements.  This overhaul is part of broader capital rule adjustments.

title: US stocks today: US stocks slip as Treasury yields rise, investors weigh Fed outlook
description: US stocks fell on Friday as higher Treasury yields, volatile oil prices and uncertainty over the Federal Reserve’s rate path weighed on sentiment. The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq declined, while investors also tracked AI demand concerns, triple witching volatility and corporate developments involving Warren Buffett and Xenon Pharmaceuticals.

title: Yen slumps to two-week low after BOJ rate hike underwhelms
description: The Japanese yen faced a sharp decline against the dollar in the aftermath of the Bank of Japan's recent interest rate hike. This decision, which did not sit well with two dissenting policymakers, has sparked skepticism about forthcoming monetary policy adjustments. On a different note, easing oil prices reflected diminished supply concerns in Saudi Arabia, with overall currency markets exhibiting relative steadiness as traders evaluated global economic conditions.
